command_result.command: cd /app; find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; cat docs/overview.md; wc -c docs/*
cd /app/docs; cat files.md clock.md quantities.md aggregation.md output.md changelog.md
cd /app/docs; cat quantities.md | head -40; cd ..; cat tools/check_hourly.py; head -c 600 tools/approved-hourly.json; cat tests/test_hourly.py; cat data/received.txt | head; ls data | wc -l

cd /app/data; cat *.log | tr -d '\r' | grep -a '^ *#' | sed 's/[0-9]/9/g' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -80; file * | grep -v 'ASCII text' | head; grep -c $'\xef\xbb\xbf' *.log | grep -v ':0' | head -3
cd /app; mkdir -p out; python3 bin/hourly.py data out/hourly.json; echo $?; python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -5; python tools/check_hourly.py
cd /app; ls -la out; python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -5; python tools/check_hourly.py 2>&1 | tail -20

cd /app; echo '{"status": "success", "summary": "Wrote /app/bin/hourly.py implementing the documented rules (units, tz, sync-based drift correction, dedup by upload, coverage, vector wind mean, rain counter) and generated /app/out/hourly.json.
